beur-hagra/3:_: There is no saying. Because the sages said:
peri-megadim/1:_: In Barakah 17 in the Gemara, he opened a small handful under the Rish, and he saw, we would have a small handful, a small handful, and a small handful, and there would be a small handful for payment, and it is called a small handful, and it is called a small handful in the Spanish language, and look at MA and ZS 16 in a handful, we would say a small handful and a relish in a vain (it is possible that the word small is missing in the print) but if the relish in a hirak would be a large handful, as in Zechariah 5:8, this is the rabbi's conviction and prayerful arrangement The great grammarian, Moharr Zalman Hana, the late late, does not now have a T.I. and M.S. Zadim in the hands of practitioners of your Torah in my book of the Magid. I wrote from it to make them remember your Torah, things that have meaning and wisdom in them. They were jealous of this because it is your wisdom and your understanding in the eyes of the nations, but to pass on the laws of your will was requested by the people of Israel, and we do the will of the Omnipresent alone without any reason. This is not because of jealousy, only malice in their hearts without any I was mistaken and you, in your great mercy, stood in the time of their trouble, even though they did not precede a prayer for many troubles, revenge, etc., not per the way of nature, only a famous miracle, for you delivered heroes to the weak and many to the few, and impure in a pure hand, per the Holy Zohar. And what did the Omnipresent do? They, out of their hatred, wanted to abolish the epistle of the laws, which does not contain jealousy. the Omnipresent, in the hands of the practitioners of Your Torah, ad the blessing of the Torah, to deal with the words of the Torah, which were excellent to look at and ponder over them, in the name of the truth, and the researcher has already said that there is no joy like letting go of the doubts that arise in the hands of the practitioners of Your Torah, ad my servants will be happy, and there I extended:
peri-megadim/2:_: There is no 17, refer to 2i and it is Shabbat 19th Devar Torah, a sacrificial offering is added to them and Rosh Chodesh Nami Halchak is ordered to be mentioned in prayer, and they return it during Hanukkah.
